items.t: Supports increasing funding and support of small businesses across Nebraska.
items.q: In Congress I will: - Increase funding and support of small businesses across Nebraska, giving them the tools they need to innovate, hire and grow.

items.t: Supports efforts to provide the personnel, training and technology needed to secure America's borders.

items.t: Supports creating a fair path to citizenship for long term immigrants who have worked and paid taxes for decades as essential workers and Dreamers.
items.q: Work to create a fair path to citizenship for long term immigrants who have worked and paid taxes for decades as essential workers and Dreamers

items.t: Supports working to pass legislation like the Right to IVF Act to expand insurance coverage for fertility treatments in health insurance plans.
items.q: Work to pass legislation like the Right to IVF Act to expand insurance coverage for fertility treatments in health insurance plans, including for federal employees, veterans, and Medicare/Medicaid recipients.

items.t: Supports reestablishing USAID and other key U.S. programs.
items.q: Fight to reestablish USAID and other key U.S. programs, while also working to rebuild relationships with key allies to rebuild America’s position as a true world leader.

items.t: Supports codifying the right to contraception by supporting the Right to Contraception Act.
items.q: Fight to codify the right to contraception by supporting the Right to Contraception Act that would protect the right of people to obtain and use contraception and protect the healthcare providers who prescribe them.

bio: Denise Powell is a mom, small business owner, former corporate executive, public school champion and healthcare advocate who knows that a strong work ethic and a love of family and community is the Nebraska way of life.
